name: Integer Lorenzo Predictor
description: Plain integer N-D Lorenzo predictor (delta coding / prefix sum). Forward: computes per-element delta from neighbor(s) using 1-D, 2-D, or 3-D inclusion-exclusion. Inverse: prefix sum to reconstruct. Lossless; output is the same signed type as input. Optional block-local reset mirrors the cuSZp 1-D block design; optional second-order and mean-centering modes follow FSZ. Both relationships are independent algorithmic reimplementations.

config.name: blockSize
config.description: Block-local reset period (elements). 0 = default N-D behavior (full-array delta). >0 forces the 1-D path, restarting the prediction chain every n elements. cuSZp uses n=32. Must be in [1, 1024] when non-zero.

config.name: centering
config.description: Subtract a per-block integer mean before prediction. Requires blockSize > 0 and adds a means output port. Follows the FSZ centered-prediction design.

config.name: order
config.description: First- or second-order prediction. Order 2 requires blockSize > 0 and follows FSZ's LZ2 design.
